systems.system: Centro Integrado de Segurança Pública (CISP) da Lunda-Sul
systems.platform: Video-surveillance network of more than 100 cameras in a first phase, traffic management, occurrence management at the centre, intelligent-camera monitoring and tools for criminal investigation bodies
systems.owner: CISP, under its director-general; directors of Ministry of the Interior offices attended
systems.tiers: Planned: foundation stone laid in Saurimo on 2026-07-30, to serve Saurimo, Cassengo and Muanguenji; the director-general says the centres are being extended to almost every province

note: The foundation stone of an integrated security centre in Saurimo: video surveillance, traffic and the centre's own handling of occurrences. It does not say that police stations record reports or cases in it, so it is a surveillance system and gives no fact.
